rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not liked or lacks popularity.

example.english: Although this movie is well made, it is unpopular locally.
example.traditional: 呢套戲雖然拍得好，但喺本地唔受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 seoi1 jin4 paak3 dak1 hou2 daan6 hai2 bun2 dei6 m4 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this mainly for a person, performer, work, or product that has failed to become popular or famous.

example.english: They used to sing very well, but they have always been unpopular.
example.traditional: 佢哋以前唱歌好好聽，可惜一直都唔紅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji5 cin4 coeng3 go1 hou2 hou2 teng1 ho2 sik1 jat1 zik6 dou1 m4 hung4

rows.note: Use this for a relatively obscure or less-popular subject, choice, activity, or field rather than for general dislike.

example.english: Not many people study this unpopular subject.
example.traditional: 呢個冷門學科讀嘅人唔多。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 laang5 mun2 hok6 fo1 duk6 ge3 jan4 m4 do1
